meta.about: Domain alias groups for MCAT terminology. Each group is a set of phrases treated as equivalent for query expansion (retrieval) and claim normalization (checker).
meta.how_it_is_used: If any phrase in a group appears in a query/claim, the tokens of every other phrase in the group are added. This is standard synonym-based query expansion; it is decided from general MCAT terminology, NOT tuned to the gold set.
meta.honesty_note: These are genuine terminology equivalences (abbreviations and standard synonyms). They are the ONLY thing that separates the Vantage retriever from the plain BM25 baseline, so any recall gain is attributable to expansion (plus light stemming).
